translations.web: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
translations.bsb: He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.
translations.kjv: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right
translations.asv: The Rock, his work is perfect; For all his ways are justice: A God of faithfulness and without iniquity, Just and right is he.
